name: FOSHAN HAITIAN FLAVOURING-H
summary: Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd., founded in 1955 and headquartered in Foshan, makes and sells condiments, beverages, food and agricultural products and exports worldwide. Its lineup includes soy sauce, oyster sauce, vinegar, cooking wine, chicken bouillon, sesame oil, MSG and pickles. It also has side businesses in packaging, catering, consulting, leasing and real estate, and belongs to Guangdong Haitian Group Co., Ltd.
